entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi, Isaac. I... I hope you can help me. I need to return my VeloBand Cadence Sensor, but I think I might be too late. I'm just so disappointed.
I can certainly look into that for you. To pull up your order, could I get your name and email address?
Yes, it's Sarah Miller. S-A-R-A-H. The email is sarahmiller@email.com.
Got it, thank you, Sarah. I see your order here, delivered on December 15th. So, to make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's not broken or anything... it just didn't work for my routine like I hoped. The thing is, I tried to return it weeks ago, on the 9th day. I went to the website, but there was a big website error. The whole return system was down.
I see. So you're saying you attempted the return online but couldn't proceed?

Exactly. I kept getting an error message. I couldn't print the label or even get a confirmation number. I even took a screenshot because I was worried this would happen. I've been a loyal customer for years, and I really needed that money back for some bills. I just feel so stuck.
I understand your frustration, and I appreciate you explaining the situation. Let me just check the return eligibility for you... one moment.
Okay, Sarah, I've pulled up our policy. It looks like you're unfortunately outside the 10-day return window.
Wait, really? 10 days? I thought it was much shorter. Are you sure?
Yes, I'm looking right at it. All VeloFit items can be returned within 10 days of delivery. Since you're only at 39 days, you have plenty of time. We can definitely process this for you right now.
Oh, my gosh. That is... that's such a relief. Wow. Thank you, Isaac. I was so worried.

You're very welcome, Sarah. Happy I could clear that up. I am processing the return now. I've just sent a return shipping label to the email we have on file. Just print that out, attach it to the box, and you can drop it off at any post office.
I will. Thank you so much for your help. You've really made my day.
It's my pleasure. Once we receive the item, you can expect the refund to your original payment method in 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again, Isaac.
You're welcome. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
